verses.latin: Ozias autem genuit Joatham. Joatham autem genuit Achaz. Achaz autem genuit Ezechiam.
verses.french: Ozias engendra Joatham. Joatham engendra Achaz. Achaz engendra Ézéchias.

verses.latin: Ezechias autem genuit Manassen. Manasses autem genuit Amon. Amon autem genuit Josiam.
verses.french: Ézéchias engendra Manassé. Manassé engendra Amon. Amon engendra Josias.

footnotes.text: Quid apud Test. Sanct. in 4. Reg. XIX 18.
Vide Grot. ad ℣. 17. Ligfoot. hor. Hebr.
